title: Still Image Animation Spec
description: One still image plus motion parameters for animate_still.py. Paths are relative to --root.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema pointer for editors.

source.description: Existing image path relative to --root. No absolute paths or .. segments.

output.description: Derived MP4 path relative to --root. No absolute paths or .. segments.

fit_mode.description: crop fills the frame with motion; contain keeps the full image over a blurred background.

motion.description: Single motion for the scene. Pan and zoom are mutually exclusive styles.

focus_x.description: Normalized horizontal focus in [0,1]. For faces, aim between the eyes.

focus_y.description: Normalized vertical focus in [0,1]. Most important for zoom motion.

pan_easing.description: Pan speed curve for pan_left and pan_right across the full horizontal range. focus_dwell: faster at edges, slower near focus_x without stopping; linear: constant speed.

title.description: Optional burned-in title text for the full scene. Requires FFmpeg drawtext and a system font.

title_position.description: Use middle over unimportant background when lower positions would cover faces; bottom is not suitable for YouTube delivery UI.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing output file.

fade_in.description: 0.2 s fade from black at scene start.

fade_out.description: 0.2 s fade to black at scene end.
